130:t_000:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「We've arrived at the target location.」

130:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「To think this is the famed $$第３新東京市$$...」

130:t_000:2.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Not only the city on the surface, but the $$ジオフロント$$, including $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ Headquarters, has vanished completely.」

130:t_000:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「Please choose your words carefully. ...They haven't vanished... They've only transferred to another world.」

130:t_000:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「No... You're not at fault, XO. Seeing that event, which could be called a $$サードインパクト$$, and these ruins would make anyone feel that way...」

130:t_000:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「But at least we must keep believing they're safe.」

130:t_000:8.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Captain, the observation team reports that no contamination has been detected in the atmosphere or the rest of the environment.」

130:t_000:9.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「We've also received requests for permission to go ashore.」

130:t_000:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「I'll leave that decision to Captain $$アムロ$$. The pilots must have feelings of their own about this.」

130:t_000:11.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「...Captain! There's an urgent transmission from Director $$大塚$$!」

130:t_000:12.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ forces thought to be invading $$新日本$$ are reportedly heading this way!」

130:t_000:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「Permission to go ashore is canceled! Prepare to launch immediately!」

130:t_000:14.en:
$$レイアム$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is coming!」

130:t_001:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「There are so many! Are they launching an all-out attack?!」

130:t_001:1.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「All units are ready to launch!」

130:t_001:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Launch them at once! The enemy is going all in!」

130:t_002:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So their commander is $$ダバラーン・タウ$$...!」

130:t_002:2.en:
$n
「You're out of luck too! If you wanted to invade Japan, you should've done it while we were away!」

130:t_002:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I learned in our last battle... You are worthy rivals, able to make my $$ハイアデス$$ blood boil...!」

130:t_002:6.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That's precisely why I'll crush you before I take Japan!」

130:t_002:7.en:
$n
「Are you saying you came here just to fight us...?!」

130:t_002:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Exactly! This land, still scarred by the $$時空震動$$, will be the stage for our battle!」

130:t_002:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What does that man think war is?!」

130:t_002:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「It's a place to make my blood boil...! Battle is my very life!」

130:t_002:13.en:
$n
「When the $$時獄戦役$$ ended, everyone was happy that peace would finally come... And you trampled all over that for your own selfish reasons...!」

130:t_002:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「People like you have no place on Earth!」

130:t_002:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「You're welcome to reject me! If you see me as an enemy, try to eliminate me!」

130:t_002:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, be careful...! This time, he isn't just testing us!」

130:t_002:18.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Don't think my $$バン・アルデバル$$ is the same as the $$アドラティオ$$ from before.」

130:t_002:19.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「This is the very limb of the $$ハイアデス$$! It is the ultimate weapon, with man and warship truly united!」

130:t_002:20.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「What does he mean, man and warship united...?」

130:t_002:21.en:
$$カツ$$
「That bastard...! Is he saying he's become one with that battleship?!」

130:t_002:22.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Now, $$ハイアデス$$! Let us begin the greatest of battles!」

130:t_002:23.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「We'll dedicate our battle to Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$!」

130:t_002:24.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, intercept! Don't let these battle maniacs do as they please in Japan!」

130:t_002:25.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We can't lose... to people like this...!」

130:t_002:26.en:
$n
「$$ダバラーン・タウ$$! We'll stop you!」

130:t_003:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「As expected, $c! You're holding out well against my furious assault!」

130:t_003:1.en:
$$カツ$$
「You call that a furious assault?! You're just relying on numbers and brute force!」

130:t_003:2.en:
$$エマ$$
「I hate to admit it, but if we keep fighting like this, our losses will skyrocket too...!」

130:t_003:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If only $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ were here...」

130:t_003:4.en:
$n
「...$$バナージ$$, say that line of yours for me.」

130:t_003:8.en:
$n
「We have to do it anyway, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

130:t_003:9.en:
$n
「If we retreat here, he'll tear Japan apart...! Our school would be in danger too!」

130:t_003:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I understand, $n. I'll steel myself too.」

130:t_003:11.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I like that resolve! You truly are worthy of being called my rivals!」

130:t_003:12.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But... no, precisely because of that, I won't hold back! I'll crush you with all my strength!」

130:t_003:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ダバラーン・タウ$$... You certainly are strong as both a commander and a warrior.」

130:t_003:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But it seems all you know is how to trample others with force.」

130:t_003:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Remember this! No matter how you try to crush people with force, there are countless people who will never stop resisting!」

130:t_003:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「People like that have come here.」

130:t_004:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone! $$紅月カレン$$ of the $$黒の騎士団$$ is here!」

130:t_004:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「And I, $$枢木スザク$$, am here too...!」

130:t_004:2.en:
$n
「$$カレン$$! And $$スザク$$ is here too!」

130:t_004:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「They're the $$黒の騎士団$$?! They should be fully occupied defending $$新日本$$!」

130:t_004:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The best defense is a good offense... At least, that's what our commander believes.」

130:t_004:5.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Above all, if Japan falls here, $$新日本$$ will be caught in a pincer attack.」

130:t_004:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So $$ゼクス$$ and $$ノイン$$ are here too.」

130:t_004:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$サイデリアル$$! If you think your numbers let you do whatever you want, you're dead wrong!」

130:t_004:8.en:
$n
「Don't think they're just four reinforcement machines. Each one of them is worth a thousand!」

130:t_004:13.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Exactly! With warriors said to be worth a thousand each joining us, I can't stop my blood from boiling!」

130:t_004:14.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Thank you, $c! And thank you, Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$!」

130:t_004:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「For giving me, $$ダバラーン・タウ$$, a battlefield like this!」
